posts.title: Enums. Swift's Secret Superpower.
posts.description: Enums Are Swift’s Secret Superpower If you’ve come from a language like Java, C#, or even Objective-C, you might think you know what an enum is. A list of named constants. An integer with a pretty label. Something you use for a switch statement and then forget about. That’s not what Swift enums are. posts.title: How I Turned My Broken Garage Remote Into a HomeKit Garage Door for Under $22
posts.description: A few weeks ago, my garage remote died. Completely. No LED, no click, no signs of life even after replacing the battery.
